summary: A 1934 50-ft pole L-6 lookout in Shoshone County; sources disagree on whether it was destroyed or abandoned in 1953, and none describes the site now.

events.note: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed
Shoshone County list says abandoned; conflicts with destroyed

evidence.supports: about 9 miles south of Clark Fork
built 1934 as a 50-ft pole L-6 tower; destroyed 1953
built 1934 as a 50-ft pole tower with L-6 cab
Shoshone County list gives abandoned in 1953
Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the tower as gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed; the Shoshone County list says abandoned. No source checked settles it, so the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Do not confuse with Whitetail Butte (Bonner County, us-id-whitetail-butte, 48.39815 -116.85797), a different lookout. Elevation 5,500 ft (about 1,676 m) is in source 1; elevation_m is still null in the record and is not a facts key, so it was not written. The 1953 fate conflict is open: a Coeur d'Alene National Forest list was not located in this run and could settle it. No source describes the site today. Record kind 'tower' and status 'gone' are consistent with the sources; the record's 1953 destroyed event is supported, and the 1934 build event is added here.
